failures.evidence: CI run 41340112838 at b4dff46a: the `test` job (id 124948261291) concluded failure while lint, typecheck, pi-shared, pi-legion, pi-envoy, contracts, claude-envoy, envoy-client, docs and worker-image all concluded success. The sole failure, read from the job's own logs endpoint: `--- FAIL: TestPodUpdateAbortsTheReplacementForAClaimTheGroupNeverHeld` / `podupdate_test.go:1693: the pod was replaced 0 times once every worker of the issue answered, want once`. The test is this change's own (packages/daemon/internal/daemon/podupdate_test.go). It is a flaky assertion, not a product defect: production is correct (the next 250ms sweep replaces the pod; no work is lost), but the test asserts too early. Its final block is `rig.signal(tester); rig.tick(); if len(rig.replacements()) != 1 { fatal }` (lines 1691-1694) -- one sweep, then an immediate read, with no await. completePodUpdate reads the group `live` with the Deciding-mask (roundView): a claim whose machine is transiently deciding at that read counts as not-answered, so `waitingClaims(live) > 0` and the replacement is deferred to the next sweep (podupdate.go:216-222). Under the full package's concurrency in CI a machine is still settling a decision at the single tick, so ReplacePod is 0 that tick and the assertion fails. The file's round-state assertions poll (awaitRound/awaitClaim); this final ReplacePod check does not. I could not reproduce it locally (isolation x1, x8, x120 under 4x CPU load, and my full ./internal/... run all passed), which is consistent with a rare scheduling race; the CI run is the reproduction. Fix: have the final step await the replacement -- poll rig.replacements() to 1, or awaitClaim the tester's round cleared (UpdateRound=="") -- before asserting, the way the rest of the test awaits round state, so the deferred-one-sweep case passes. The two earlier ReplacePod==0 assertions in the same test are correct as they stand (they assert nothing-yet while a worker has not answered, which no deferral can turn into a spurious replacement).
